label: CF Tunnel
_note: Checked via tmux, not pgrep/proc: Android's /proc hides other processes, so reading /proc/*/exe finds nothing and the tunnel reads as down while it is fine. Session is 'cloudflare', process is 'cloudflared'.
start: tmux new-session -d -s cloudflare 'cloudflared tunnel run my-phone'

label: ntfy
start: tmux new-session -d -s ntfy 'proot-distro login ubuntu -- ntfy serve'

label: Hermes
start: tmux new-session -d -s hermes 'proot-distro login ubuntu -- bash -c "hermes gateway run"'

label: Ideas
_note: Idea board on port 2124, served at ideas.prayas.space. Runs its own Flask app with per-user accounts and a SQLite DB at ~/ideas.db — it does not use WEBHOOK_TOKEN. See docs/ideas.md.

label: Forza
start: tmux new-session -d -s forza 'cd cyberdeck/forza && python3 forza_listener.py'

label: Desk Buddy
_note: Voice-assistant broker on port 2125. Runs INSIDE proot Ubuntu (glibc) because openWakeWord's ML runtime ships only glibc aarch64 wheels — Termux's bionic libc can't load them. Binds the Termux ~/cyberdeck into proot so it runs the same repo copy; PULSE_SERVER points at the Termux PulseAudio bridge for speaker playback. Checked via tmux, not pgrep — Android's /proc hides processes. See docs/deskbuddy.md.
start: tmux new-session -d -s buddy 'proot-distro login ubuntu --bind /data/data/com.termux/files/home/cyberdeck:/root/cyberdeck -- bash -c "cd /root/cyberdeck/deskbuddy && PULSE_SERVER=tcp:127.0.0.1:4713 python3 broker.py"'
